title: The test suite is rewritten small, with a hard ceiling the gate enforces
goal: python3 _tools/tests.py runs a new suite of 60 to 100 test ids in 10 to 15 files in at most 20 s on the macOS host and 60 s on the Windows host; the old test files, the stress suite and their callers are gone; a ceiling file (ids, files, seconds) is enforced by the gate; CI runs the minimum that still gives publish a CI verdict; kb/_self, the skills and the kb-worker agent allow a new test only in a very limited scope and ask a retrospective, not a regression test, for a bug a log can show
